regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is the top resort at 26" over the window, with its big day Saturday at 17". Environment Canada expects rain at times, with wind gusting to 50 km/h Friday, so expect a wet, windy start before the snow arrives.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Baker leads at 8" with 5" on Saturday. The NWS forecasts rain and snow through the weekend, with snow levels dropping Saturday night and a chance of snow Monday. Crystal Mountain and Stevens Pass each see 4" or less.
